Class RentalService

java.lang.Object
najah.eng.Application.service.RentalService
public class RentalService extends Object
Provides the business logic required to rent vehicles.

The service validates the vehicle status, rental duration, customer information, active rental records, and vehicle-specific rental rules.

It prevents double booking by checking both the vehicle status and the active rental records.

After a successful rental, the service publishes a RentalEventType.RENTED event using the Observer Pattern.

    • rentVehicle

      public boolean rentVehicle(String vehicleId, String customerName, String customerEmail, int rentalDays)
      Rents a vehicle that has no additional type-specific requirements.

      This method delegates to the complete rental method using default values for age, special license, and battery level.

      Parameters:
      vehicleId - the ID of the vehicle
      customerName - the customer name
      customerEmail - the customer email
      rentalDays - the number of rental days
      Returns:
      true when the rental succeeds; otherwise false

    • rentVehicle

      public boolean rentVehicle(String vehicleId, String customerName, String customerEmail, int rentalDays, int customerAge, boolean hasSpecialLicense, int batteryLevel)
      Rents a vehicle after validating all general and type-specific rules.

      The operation performs the following validations:

      • The vehicle exists.
      • The vehicle has no active rental.
      • The vehicle status is Available.
      • The rental duration is between 1 and 30 days.
      • The customer name and email are provided.
      • The vehicle-specific rental strategy accepts the request.

      If saving the rental fails after updating the vehicle status, the vehicle status is restored to Available.

      Parameters:
      vehicleId - the ID of the vehicle
      customerName - the customer name
      customerEmail - the customer email
      rentalDays - the requested rental duration
      customerAge - the age of the customer
      hasSpecialLicense - whether the customer has a special license
      batteryLevel - the electric vehicle battery level
      Returns:
      true when the rental is completed successfully; otherwise false
